english.title: Sell alcohol to a child on two or more different occasions
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) on two or more different occasions, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INDIVIDUAL DATES..), which were within a period of three consecutive months, unlawfully sold alcohol on the same premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), to an individual aged under 18 years of age and at the time of each sale those premises were licensed premises or premises authorised to be used for a permitted temporary activity by virtue of Part 5 of the Licensing Act 2003 and you were a responsible person in relation to the premises on the occasion of each sale
english.legislation: Contrary to section 147A of the Licensing Act 2003.

english.notes:
(i) Section 28 of the Policing and Crime Act 2009 has reduced the occasions of sale to two.
(ii) Fine increased to £20,000 by s118 of the the Police Reform and Social Responsibility Act 2011on 25/04/12
